mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.content AS content, p.bgm_url AS bgmUrl, p.is_subscriber_only AS isSubscriberOnly, p.hashtags AS hashtags, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.id AS memberId, m.nickname AS authorName, m.profile_image AS authorProfileImage FROM post_main p INNER JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.id WHERE p.id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_main WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND type = 1

SELECT post.id, post.content, post.is_subscriber_only, post.hashtags, img.image_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_interaction interact WHERE interact.post_id = post.id AND interact.interaction_type = 'LIKE') AS like_count FROM post_main post LEFT JOIN post_image img ON img.post_id = post.id AND img.sort_order = 0 WHERE type = 1 AND post.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY post.created_at DESC

SELECT post.id, post.content, post.is_subscriber_only, post.hashtags, img.image_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_interaction interact WHERE interact.post_id = post.id AND interact.interaction_type = 'LIKE') AS like_count FROM post_main post LEFT JOIN post_image img ON img.post_id = post.id AND img.sort_order = 0 WHERE type = 2 AND post.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY post.created_at DESC

SELECT post.id,post.content,post.is_subscriber_only,post.hashtags, img.image_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_interaction li WHERE li.post_id = post.id AND li.interaction_type = 'LIKE') AS like_count FROM post_interaction bm INNER JOIN post_main post ON post.id = bm.post_id LEFT JOIN post_image img ON img.post_id = post.id AND img.sort_order = 0 WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND bm.interaction_type = 'BOOKMARK' ORDER BY bm.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_main ( member_id, content, bgm_url, is_subscriber_only, hashtags, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{content}, #{bgmUrl}, COALESCE(#{isSubscriberOnly}, 0), #{hashtags}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO post_image (post_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES
(#{postId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE post_main SET content = #{request.content}, bgm_url = #{request.bgmUrl}, is_subscriber_only = #{request.isSubscriberOnly}, hashtags = #{request.hashtags}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_main WHERE id = #{postId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
